pipeline: tests/make_phased_trace.py over the pool, then tests/annotate_trace_slo.py for the SLO tier
_comment: Same prompt pool and arrival plan for every model; only the model/GPU changes across the matrix.  The pool itself is not committed (69 MB); regenerating it gives the same prompts only if the same CNN/DailyMail sample is used, so these jsonl files are the artifact of record.
_slo_comment: Budget relaxed from 500 ms to 1500 ms: 500 is below the pool's own service floor at these peaks, so every (prefill, decode) pair violates and slo_penalty degenerates to a constant offset.  See docs/实验数据集与对比基线说明.md 6.22.
